articles.title_en: Take an inch for a mile. About an error of metrics in WTO rules and its impact on the ability of countries to build public stocks for food security
articles.title_cn: 得寸进尺：WTO规则中的度量误差及其对各国建立粮食安全公共储备能力的影响
articles.abstract_en: Many developing countries use public stocks to provide free or subsidised grain to food-insecure households or to mitigate sharp increases in grain prices. However, the building of public stocks is regulated by the WTO, as public procurement may be used to provide farmers with a price support. This support is bounded jointly with the other forms of non-exempt domestic support for agriculture. Since 2012, WTO rules on public stockholding programmes have been questioned by a group of 33 member countries, and are at the top of the WTO negotiation agenda. The topics debated are i) the way this support should be calculated, and ii) the maximum level of support allowed. This article addresses the first topic. It identifies three biases in WTO rules and estimates the magnitude of the gap between the support actually provided and the support calculated according to WTO rules. It appears that, for grains, the support calculated is generally several times higher than the real support, compromising countries’ compliance with their domestic support commitments and thereby significantly reducing their ability to build public stocks. Moreover, the gap is not the same for all countries and is generally much higher for poor countries: the countries that most need public stocks for food security are those with the least freedom to build them. This article thus proposes a simple way to correct the rules that specify how the support provided by public stockholding programmes should be calculated.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多发展中国家利用公共储备向粮食不安全家庭提供免费或补贴谷物，或缓解谷物价格的急剧上涨。然而，公共储备的建立受到WTO的监管，因为公共采购可能被用来向农民提供价格支持。这种支持与非豁免的国内农业支持的其他形式共同受到约束。自2012年以来，WTO关于公共储备计划的规则受到33个成员国的质疑，并处于WTO谈判议程的首要位置。争论的主题包括：i) 这种支持的计算方式，以及ii) 允许的最大支持水平。本文针对第一个主题。它识别了WTO规则中的三个偏差，并估计了实际提供的支持与根据WTO规则计算的支持之间的差距大小。结果表明，对于谷物，计算出的支持通常比实际支持高出数倍，这损害了各国遵守其国内支持承诺的能力，从而显著降低了它们建立公共储备的能力。此外，这种差距并非对所有国家都相同，对贫穷国家而言通常要大得多：最需要公共储备以保障粮食安全的国家，恰恰是建立储备自由度最小的国家。因此，本文提出了一种简单的方法来修正规定公共储备计划支持计算方式的规则。

articles.title_en: When increasing vegetable production may worsen food availability gaps: A simulation model in India
articles.title_cn: 当增加蔬菜生产可能加剧食物供应缺口时：印度的一个模拟模型
articles.abstract_en: Translating agricultural productivity into food availability depends on food supply chains. Agricultural policy and research efforts promote increased horticultural crop production and yields, but the ability of low-resource food supply chains to handle increased volumes of perishable crops is not well understood. This study developed and used a discrete event simulation model to assess the impact of increased production of potato, onion, tomato, brinjal (eggplant), and cabbage on vegetable supply chains in Odisha, India. Odisha serves as an exemplar of vegetable supply chain challenges in many low-resource settings.
articles.abstract_cn: 将农业生产力转化为食物供应依赖于食物供应链。农业政策和研究工作促进了园艺作物产量和单产的提高，但低资源食物供应链处理易腐作物数量增加的能力尚不明确。本研究开发并使用了离散事件模拟模型，评估印度奥里萨邦马铃薯、洋葱、番茄、茄子（茄子）和卷心菜产量增加对蔬菜供应链的影响。奥里萨邦是许多低资源环境中蔬菜供应链挑战的典型代表。

articles.title_en: Income diversification and household welfare in Uganda 1992–2012
articles.title_cn: 乌干达的收入多样化与家庭福利（1992-2012）
articles.abstract_en: We use five waves of household surveys in Uganda, from 1992/3 to 2011/12, to study income diversification and its effect on the welfare of rural and urban households during a period of sustained economic growth and poverty reduction, comparing the 1990s to the 2000s, and disaggregating by gender of the household head. Diversification is measured in terms of access to incomes from agriculture (farming), agricultural wage, self-employment (informal), wage employment and remittances. The analysis shows substantial and evolving variation in the effects of diversification across rural/urban locations and gender of the household head. Diversification became increasingly beneficial for welfare over time in rural areas, particularly for male headed households, but not for female headed households that diversified into agricultural wage employment. Diversification was also important for the livelihoods of urban households, but with large differences across male and female headed households likely reflecting differentials in the returns to non-agricultural employment. Remittances were associated with increasing welfare in the 2000s for all households, although the proportion of households receiving remittances has been declining.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用乌干达从1992/3到2011/12的五轮家庭调查数据，研究在持续经济增长和减贫时期，收入多样化及其对农村和城市家庭福利的影响，比较1990年代与2000年代，并按户主性别进行分解。多样化以获取农业（耕作）、农业工资、自雇（非正式）、工资就业和汇款收入的途径来衡量。分析显示，多样化效应在农村/城市地区和户主性别之间存在显著且不断变化的差异。随着时间的推移，多样化对农村地区家庭的福利越来越有益，特别是对男性户主家庭，但对那些多样化进入农业工资就业的女性户主家庭则不然。多样化对城市家庭的生计也很重要，但男性和女性户主家庭之间存在较大差异，这可能反映了非农就业回报的差异。在2000年代，汇款与所有家庭的福利增加相关，尽管收到汇款的家庭比例一直在下降。

articles.title_en: A global view of aquaculture policy
articles.title_cn: 水产养殖政策的全球视角
articles.abstract_en: Aquaculture is among the most dynamic sectors in the global food system, yet it remains surprisingly under-represented in the mainstream literature on food policy. This article reviews 204 published articles and reports and shows that government policies have strongly influenced the geographic distribution of aquaculture growth, as well as the types of species, technology, management practices, and infrastructure adopted in different locations. Global cross-section studies reveal a broad spectrum of under- to over-regulated aquaculture systems that correspond, respectively, to high- and low-growth areas for aquaculture. The bulk of this paper centers on aquaculture policy as it plays out six individual countries plus the EU: Bangladesh, Zambia, Chile, China, USA, and Norway. These case studies shed light on aquaculture policies aimed at economic development, aquaculture disease management, siting, environmental performance, and trade protection. Experiences from these countries point to the need to find the right policy balance between semi-subsistence farms, small and medium enterprises (SME), and large-scale commercial operations, particularly in low-income settings. The cases also highlight the importance of addressing aquaculture disease pressures and misuse of antimicrobials in many parts of the world, and identifying successful aquaculture policy instruments and institutions that can be transferred between countries. The review underscores the challenges of establishing nutrition-sensitive aquaculture policies and of incorporating aquaculture directly into food policy and global food system dialogues and action.
articles.abstract_cn: 水产养殖是全球食品体系中最具活力的部门之一，但在主流食品政策文献中却出人意料地代表性不足。本文回顾了204篇已发表的文章和报告，并表明政府政策强烈影响了水产养殖增长的地理分布，以及不同地点采用的物种、技术、管理实践和基础设施类型。全球横截面研究揭示了从监管不足到过度监管的水产养殖系统的广泛谱系，这些系统分别对应于水产养殖的高增长和低增长区域。本文的大部分内容集中在六个国家加上欧盟的水产养殖政策：孟加拉国、赞比亚、智利、中国、美国和挪威。这些案例研究揭示了旨在促进经济发展、水产养殖疾病管理、选址、环境绩效和贸易保护的水产养殖政策。这些国家的经验表明，需要找到半自给农场、中小企业和大型商业运营之间的适当政策平衡，特别是在低收入环境中。这些案例还强调了解决世界许多地区水产养殖疾病压力和抗菌药物滥用问题的重要性，以及识别可在国家间转移的成功水产养殖政策工具和制度。本综述强调了制定营养敏感型水产养殖政策以及将水产养殖直接纳入食品政策和全球食品体系对话与行动的挑战。

articles.title_en: Mobile Phones and Mozambique Traders: Size, Composition and Distribution of Reduced Transaction Costs
articles.title_cn: 手机与莫桑比克贸易商：交易成本降低的规模、构成与分布
articles.abstract_en: I use unique transport cost data along with spatial market prices to measure the size, composition and distribution of reduced transactions costs due to the roll-out of the mobile phone network in Mozambique. My estimations are based on weekly transport costs of maize grain and weekly maize market prices. The mobile phone roll-out explains a 9%-15% reduction in the spatial price dispersion of maize. The evidence suggests that 70% to 80% comes from lower transport costs. Traders use mobile phones for multiple alternative purposes which explains the large contribution of transport costs. The evidence also indicates that the reduction in spatial price dispersion corresponds with a relatively large drop in destination markets’ prices: the benefits of mobile phones appear to accrue mainly to urban consumer markets and much less to producer areas. My results are robust for the non-random roll-out of the mobile phone network and several other threats, and align with evidence found elsewhere in the literature.
articles.abstract_cn: 我利用独特的运输成本数据以及空间市场价格来衡量莫桑比克移动电话网络推广所导致的交易成本降低的规模、构成与分布。我的估计基于玉米谷物的每周运输成本和每周玉米市场价格。移动电话的推广解释了玉米空间价格离散度降低的9%-15%。证据表明，其中70%至80%来自较低的运输成本。贸易商将手机用于多种替代目的，这解释了运输成本的巨大贡献。证据还表明，空间价格离散度的降低与目的地市场价格的相对大幅下降相对应：移动电话的收益似乎主要归于城市消费市场，而生产者地区受益较少。我的结果对于移动电话网络的非随机推广及其他若干威胁是稳健的，并与文献中其他地方发现的证据一致。

articles.title_en: Review: Purchased agricultural input quality and small farms
articles.title_cn: 综述：购买的农业投入品质量与小农户
articles.abstract_en: Adoption of non-labor agricultural inputs remains low among small-scale farmers in many low-income countries. Accurate measurement of the quality of these inputs and quantities used is essential for assessing economic returns, understanding the drivers of agricultural productivity, and proposing and evaluating policies for increasing agricultural production. We review evidence regarding the quality of planting material, fertilizer and pesticides used by small farmers in low-income countries with a focus on Sub-Saharan Africa where the literature is most extensive. We distill four key findings. First, empirical evidence to date has centered on a limited set of agricultural inputs and locations. Second, some of this evidence is difficult to evaluate or may be misleading because best testing practices either were not followed or were not sufficiently documented. Third, while farmers are generally suspicious about input quality and therefore may hesitate to invest, these beliefs may exaggerate the severity of the problem. Farmers may attribute too much blame to poor quality inputs for bad crop yield outcomes. Fourth, most evidence comes from on-farm or in-shop samples; where input quality issues emerge at these downstream stages it is typically unclear where and how problems enter the upstream supply chain. We argue that while accurate documentation of measured and perceived agricultural input quality is important, the marginal productivity effects of input use hinge on the timing and method of application and on a host of complementary inputs (e.g., soils, moisture, labor). We conclude with specific priorities for future research that are linked to these key findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多低收入国家，小农户对非劳动农业投入品的采用率仍然较低。准确衡量这些投入品的质量和使用数量对于评估经济回报、理解农业生产率的驱动因素以及提出和评估增加农业生产的政策至关重要。我们回顾了关于低收入国家小农户使用的种植材料、化肥和农药质量的证据，重点关注文献最为丰富的撒哈拉以南非洲地区。我们提炼出四个关键发现。第一，迄今为止的经验证据集中在有限的农业投入品种类和地点上。第二，其中一些证据难以评估或可能具有误导性，因为最佳测试实践要么未被遵循，要么未被充分记录。第三，虽然农民通常对投入品质量持怀疑态度，因此可能犹豫是否投资，但这些信念可能夸大了问题的严重性。农民可能将作物产量不佳的结果过多归咎于投入品质量差。第四，大多数证据来自农场或商店内的样本；当投入品质量问题在这些下游阶段出现时，通常不清楚问题在何处以及如何进入上游供应链。我们认为，虽然准确记录测量和感知的农业投入品质量很重要，但投入品使用的边际生产力效应取决于施用的时间和方法以及一系列互补投入品（例如土壤、水分、劳动力）。最后，我们提出了与这些关键发现相关的未来研究的具体优先事项。

articles.title_en: Geographical Indications and Innovation: Evidence from EU regions
articles.title_cn: 地理标志与创新：来自欧盟地区的证据
articles.abstract_en: Understanding the relationship between the diffusion of geographical indications (GIs) and innovation in the agri-food sector represents a relevant research area not yet properly addressed by the current literature. Our contribution aims to fill this gap by investigating the extent to which the diffusion of GIs across EU regions affects technological innovation. We investigate this issue through a Neo-Schumpeterian 'distance-to-the-frontier' model, according to which the relation between the diffusion of GIs and innovations is non-monotonic and depends on the distance of firms and local systems from the technological frontier. To test this prediction, we build an original longitudinal dataset that includes information on GIs and agri-food patents in 265 EU regions over the period 1996–2014. Using different estimators and different proxies for innovative activities, we show that the diffusion of GIs affects innovative activities, conditional on the region’s distance from the technological frontier. That is to say, the spread of GIs slightly reduces innovation and growth in regions close to the technological frontier but spurs them on in laggard regions. These findings have important policy implications.
articles.abstract_cn: 理解地理标志（GIs）的扩散与农业食品部门创新之间的关系，是一个相关的研究领域，但当前文献尚未充分探讨。我们的贡献旨在通过调查欧盟各地区地理标志的扩散在多大程度上影响技术创新来填补这一空白。我们通过一个新熊彼特式的“距前沿距离”模型来研究这一问题，根据该模型，地理标志的扩散与创新之间的关系是非单调的，取决于企业和地方系统与技术前沿的距离。为了检验这一预测，我们构建了一个原始的纵向数据集，其中包括1996-2014年期间265个欧盟地区的地理标志和农业食品专利信息。使用不同的估计量和不同的创新活动代理变量，我们表明地理标志的扩散影响创新活动，这取决于该地区与技术前沿的距离。也就是说，地理标志的传播在接近技术前沿的地区略微减少了创新和增长，但在落后地区则促进了创新和增长。这些发现具有重要的政策含义。

articles.title_en: Does the provision of information increase the substitution of animal proteins with plant-based proteins? An experimental investigation into consumer choices
articles.title_cn: 提供信息是否会增加植物蛋白对动物蛋白的替代？一项关于消费者选择的实验研究
articles.abstract_en: A widespread transition towards diets based on plant proteins as substitutes for animal proteins would contribute to food system sustainability. Such changes in consumer food choices can be fostered by public policy. We conducted a field experiment to test whether providing consumers with information regarding the negative consequences of meat consumption on the environment or health increases the substitution of animal-based proteins with plant-based proteins. The consumers had to make three meal selections online and consume the products at home, the first without exposure to information and the latter two after exposure to environmental or health information. One group of consumers served as the control and received no information. The results show that half of the consumers consumed meals with animal proteins in all three cases. Observational learning does not enhance the impact of the information intervention. However, for a sub-sample of consumers, environmental information increases the likelihood of consuming plant-based protein products. Overall, a short-term information policy does not appear to be sufficient for altering consumer behaviour regarding the consumption of animal proteins.
articles.abstract_cn: 向以植物蛋白替代动物蛋白的饮食广泛转变将有助于食品系统的可持续性。消费者食品选择的这种变化可以通过公共政策来促进。我们进行了一项实地实验，以检验向消费者提供关于肉类消费对环境或健康的负面后果的信息是否会增加以植物蛋白替代动物蛋白的比例。消费者需要在网上进行三次膳食选择并在家中食用产品，第一次在未接触信息的情况下，后两次在接触环境或健康信息之后。一组消费者作为对照组，未收到任何信息。结果显示，一半的消费者在所有三次选择中都食用了含动物蛋白的膳食。观察学习并未增强信息干预的效果。然而，对于一部分消费者子样本，环境信息增加了消费植物蛋白产品的可能性。总体而言，短期信息政策似乎不足以改变消费者对动物蛋白消费的行为。

articles.title_en: How is nutrition, health and wellbeing conceptualised in connection with seafood for coastal Indigenous Peoples’
articles.title_cn: 沿海原住民的营养、健康与福祉如何与海产品相关联
articles.abstract_en: Coastal Indigenous people access and maintain customary connections to seafood for nourishment, livelihoods and Indigenous values. It is recognised that seafood contributes significantly to coastal Indigenous people’s diets. Despite this, global fisheries sectors have overlooked the role seafood plays in contributing to nutritional, health and wellbeing outcomes of coastal Indigenous communities. Global entities have called for ‘nutrition sensitive policies’ to improve nutritional, health and wellbeing outcomes. The aim of this study was to apply an ‘Indigenist’ inquiry lens and ‘yarning’ as a method to further understand from an Indigenous perspective how concepts of nutritional, health and wellbeing outcomes are represented and connected to seafood. Research involved 16 Aboriginal informants, six women and ten men from a fishing enterprise, arts and culture centre and a women’s centre with a connection to commercial and customary fishing in Maningrida community in the Northern Territory of Australia, 2019–2022. Key themes related to respecting of Elders, culture, country, Aboriginal nutrition, traditional medicinal knowledge, Aboriginal fishing enterprises, barriers to accessing seafood, lived experience, intergenerational knowledge transfer and interconnectedness. It is clear that fishing and access to seafood for Aboriginal people is a pathway to healthier food provision within coastal Indigenous communities. It needs to be recognised however, that Indigenous nutritional, health and wellbeing concepts and self-determination principles need to be integrated into ‘nutrition sensitive policies’ within fisheries and mariculture sectors.
articles.abstract_cn: 沿海原住民获取并维持与海产品的习惯性联系，以获取营养、生计和原住民价值观。人们认识到，海产品对沿海原住民的饮食贡献显著。尽管如此，全球渔业部门忽视了海产品在改善沿海原住民社区营养、健康和福祉结果方面的作用。全球实体呼吁制定“营养敏感政策”以改善营养、健康和福祉结果。本研究旨在运用“原住民主义”探究视角和“yarning”作为方法，从原住民角度进一步理解营养、健康和福祉结果的概念如何被表述并与海产品相关联。研究涉及16名原住民信息提供者，包括来自澳大利亚北领地Maningrida社区一个渔业企业、艺术与文化中心和一个妇女中心的六名女性和十名男性，他们与商业和习惯性渔业有联系，时间为2019-2022。关键主题涉及尊重长者、文化、国家、原住民营养、传统医药知识、原住民渔业企业、获取海产品的障碍、生活经验、代际知识传递和相互关联性。显然，对于原住民而言，捕鱼和获取海产品是沿海原住民社区内更健康食品供应的一条途径。然而，需要认识到，原住民的营养、健康和福祉概念以及自决原则需要被整合到渔业和水产养殖部门的“营养敏感政策”中。

articles.title_en: Less is more: Information overload in the labelling of fish and aquaculture products
articles.title_cn: 少即是多：鱼类和水产品标签中的信息过载
articles.abstract_en: Food labels have been used extensively for informing consumers to make more rational and safer decisions. However, this carries the risk of confusing consumers with multiple claims which may distract from key information such as the country of origin of the product. To inform the European legislation, we have tested labels on fish and aquaculture products in three separate experiments, across several European Member States. The main results showed that mandatory information is better recalled than voluntary information. In addition, consumers perceive, and process differently labels for farmed and caught fish, relying more on quality claims for the former. Nonetheless, in both cases, while they value visual information, they are likely to be confused by voluntary claims including flags. Finally, when additional claims are added step by step, they lead to a decrease in accuracy of recall and comprehension. In sum, less is better, because too much information on food labels lead to cognitive overload and consumer confusion.
articles.abstract_cn: 食品标签已被广泛用于告知消费者，以做出更理性和更安全的决策。然而，这存在使消费者因多重声明而感到困惑的风险，这些声明可能会分散对产品原产国等关键信息的注意力。为了给欧洲立法提供信息，我们在多个欧洲成员国的三项独立实验中测试了鱼类和水产品的标签。主要结果表明，强制性信息比自愿性信息更容易被记住。此外，消费者对养殖鱼和捕捞鱼的标签感知和处理方式不同，前者更依赖于质量声明。尽管如此，在两种情况下，虽然他们重视视觉信息，但他们可能被包括旗帜在内的自愿性声明所困惑。最后，当额外声明逐步添加时，它们会导致回忆和理解准确性的下降。总之，少即是好，因为食品标签上的过多信息会导致认知过载和消费者困惑。

articles.title_en: The effects of advisory services and technology channeling on farm yields and technical efficiency of wheat farmers in Ethiopia
articles.title_cn: 咨询服务与技术推广对埃塞俄比亚小麦农户产量和技术效率的影响
articles.abstract_en: Improving the performance of low-productivity smallholder farmers is a pathway with great potential for reducing poverty and enhancing food security and nutrition in sub-Saharan Africa. Using experimental data from Ethiopia and a mediated stochastic frontier model that accounts for endogenous treatment status, we examine the impact of advisory services and technology channeling on farm yields and efficiency. Our results show that the impact of improved extension services on yields is positive and statistically significant and that advisory services constitute a significant proportion of the output effect.
articles.abstract_cn: 提高低生产率小农户的表现是撒哈拉以南非洲减少贫困、增强粮食安全和营养的一条极具潜力的途径。利用来自埃塞俄比亚的实验数据以及一个考虑内生处理状态的介导随机前沿模型，我们考察了咨询服务和技术推广对农场产量和效率的影响。我们的结果表明，改进的推广服务对产量的影响是正向且统计显著的，并且咨询服务构成了产出效应的重要组成部分。

articles.title_en: Captive school markets, industry self-regulation, and public-private partnerships: Narratives shaping the development of alternative proteins in the United States, 1965–1982
articles.title_cn: 受控学校市场、行业自律与公私伙伴关系：塑造美国替代蛋白质发展的叙事，1965-1982年
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the interplay between government, industry and other stakeholders, and the key narratives shaping the development and regulation of alternative protein products in the US in the 1960s to early 1980s, paying particular attention to how the US National School Lunch Programme was used for the development of these products. Using internal food industry documents sourced from the University of California San Francisco (UCSF) Food Industry Documents Archive, we find that the US government proactively paved the way for industry to develop alternative protein products by: (a) providing government funding for textured vegetable protein product research and development; (b) opening the doors to lucrative markets; and (c) supporting a lenient regulatory environment for alternative protein products to be developed. A key market for textured vegetable protein products was the US National School Lunch Programme, which was treated as a captive market for developing new products and formulations. The motivations for introducing textured vegetable proteins in schools differed between government and industry, principally between: offering cost-savings and alleviating malnutrition and food insecurity versus developing profitable new food products. Industry actors actively sought to modify the regulatory environment to favour commercial interests, and the government was slow to regulate the alternative protein industry and relied on industry self-regulation. Our research is particularly relevant, because of what appears to be renewed interest in recent years in using school meal programs for the development of alternative-proteins, a phenomenon not limited to the US.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了政府、行业及其他利益相关者之间的互动，以及塑造美国1960年代至1980年代初期替代蛋白质产品发展和监管的关键叙事，特别关注美国国家学校午餐计划如何被用于这些产品的发展。利用从加州大学旧金山分校（UCSF）食品行业文件档案中获取的内部食品行业文件，我们发现美国政府通过以下方式积极为行业发展替代蛋白质产品铺平道路：（a）为组织化植物蛋白产品研发提供政府资金；（b）打开利润丰厚的市场大门；（c）支持宽松的监管环境以利于替代蛋白质产品的开发。组织化植物蛋白产品的一个关键市场是美国国家学校午餐计划，该计划被视为开发新产品和新配方的受控市场。政府和行业在将组织化植物蛋白引入学校的动机上存在差异，主要在于：提供成本节约和缓解营养不良及粮食不安全与开发有利可图的新食品产品之间的区别。行业参与者积极寻求修改监管环境以利于商业利益，而政府则对替代蛋白质行业的监管缓慢，并依赖行业自律。我们的研究尤其具有相关性，因为近年来似乎重新出现了利用学校餐计划发展替代蛋白质的兴趣，这一现象不仅限于美国。

articles.title_en: Migration, gender labor division and food insecurity in Tajikistan
articles.title_cn: 塔吉克斯坦的移民、性别劳动分工与粮食不安全
articles.abstract_en: In recent decades millions living in low-income countries like Tajikistan have migrated to support their livelihoods. This massive, predominantly male, out-migration has transformed the agricultural sector. On the one hand, household members with migrants who stay behind, usually female and children, might replace migrant member’s previous tasks, leading to the feminization of agriculture. On the other hand, remittances can increase migrant households’ income leading to a reduction in their work and increase in their food security as their purchasing power strengthens. We study the relationship between migration, food insecurity and gender labor division for two production systems in Tajikistan. Using propensity score matching with village fixed effects, we find non-migrant households are associated with having more months of food shortages and spending more days without eating food. In terms of the division of labor, women in migrant households were associated with being more involved in labor-intensive activities. Our results provide evidence that while migration is correlated with greater food security, the demand on women’s time and labour increases. This has important implications for designing gender-inclusive agricultural and irrigation training and extension programs, which are usually targeted at males. Gender-sensitive design will be vital for improving countries like Tajikistan’s food security, malnutrition, and water resource management.
articles.abstract_cn: 近几十年来，像塔吉克斯坦这样的低收入国家有数百万人为了维持生计而移民。这种大规模的、以男性为主的向外移民改变了农业部门。一方面，留守家中的家庭成员（通常是女性和儿童）可能会接替移民成员之前的工作，导致农业的女性化。另一方面，汇款可以增加移民家庭的收入，从而减少他们的劳动，并随着购买力的增强提高他们的粮食安全。我们研究了塔吉克斯坦两种生产系统中移民、粮食不安全与性别劳动分工之间的关系。使用带有村庄固定效应的倾向得分匹配，我们发现非移民家庭与更多的粮食短缺月份和更多天数不进食相关联。在劳动分工方面，移民家庭中的女性与更多参与劳动密集型活动相关联。我们的结果提供了证据表明，虽然移民与更高的粮食安全相关，但对女性时间和劳动的需求却增加了。这对设计通常针对男性的性别包容性农业和灌溉培训及推广项目具有重要意义。性别敏感的设计对于改善像塔吉克斯坦这样的国家的粮食安全、营养不良和水资源管理至关重要。

articles.title_en: Digital tools and agricultural market transformation in Africa: Why are they not at scale yet, and what will it take to get there?
articles.title_cn: 数字工具与非洲农业市场转型：为何尚未大规模推广，以及如何实现？
articles.abstract_en: Despite enthusiasm for the potential of digital innovations to transform agricultural markets in Africa, progress made thus far has been limited to small-scale experiments that often fail to scale up. Realizing the full potential of digital innovations – tools, technologies, applications, and services – in Africa requires not just further development of these solutions at meaningful scales, but also more nuanced evidence from both successful and unsuccessful scaling efforts. This paper reviews the conceptual and empirical evidence on the transformative potential of digital innovations for African agricultural markets with an in-depth examination of solutions that have been rolled out to date in the continent. Specifically, the review addresses the following questions: (i) how can digital innovations improve the functioning of agricultural markets in Africa? (ii) what explains the apparent disconnect of most pilots to scale-ups? (iii) what is required to realize their full potential? and (iv) what are the emerging risks and opportunities associated with digital innovations for agricultural marketing? Although our review of the landscape and literature on market-focused digital innovations in Africa identifies several reasons to remain optimistic, the prevailing disconnect between pilots and scale-ups merits further evaluation. In particular, there is a need for more systematic assessments of both successes and failures at both the piloting and scaling stages.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管人们对数字创新改变非洲农业市场的潜力充满热情，但迄今为止取得的进展仅限于小规模实验，这些实验往往难以扩大规模。在非洲实现数字创新——工具、技术、应用和服务——的全部潜力，不仅需要在有意义的规模上进一步开发这些解决方案，还需要从成功和失败的推广努力中获取更细致的证据。本文回顾了关于数字创新对非洲农业市场变革潜力的概念和实证证据，并深入考察了迄今为止在非洲大陆推出的解决方案。具体而言，本综述探讨了以下问题：（i）数字创新如何改善非洲农业市场的运作？（ii）是什么解释了大多数试点与推广之间的明显脱节？（iii）实现其全部潜力需要什么？（iv）与农业营销相关的数字创新带来了哪些新兴风险和机遇？尽管我们对非洲市场导向数字创新的格局和文献的回顾指出了若干保持乐观的理由，但试点与推广之间普遍存在的脱节值得进一步评估。特别是，需要对试点和推广阶段的成功与失败进行更系统的评估。
